method: Loaded C_06 by path in the worktree, ran load_static_tables and process_date read-only on the three canonical holdings partitions (one in-process run, nothing written), summed firm total and class sum as at lines 737-743, and probed classify_series for class mass outside the eight canonical classes.
cause: H1 (rounding) holds on the recomputed run: each relationship's class shares are rounded to 6 decimals at C_06 line 595, and the firm class sum accumulates rounded share times dollars at lines 737-743 (full build 857-863), while total accumulates exact dollars. The share rounding residual sum equals the recomputed gap to the cent on all three dates (2026-10-06 167.10, 2026-10-07 -120.97, 2026-10-08 -128.57), and class mass outside the eight classes is zero, so no membership difference (H2) is present. The served 2026-10-08 total, class sum and gap reproduce to the cent. The served 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07 totals do NOT reproduce: recomputed totals exceed served totals by 584,886.01 and 442,485.38, so the served snapshot was written from a different partition or static-table set (all three partitions were last written 2026-10-10T23:15Z, after the snapshot at 2026-10-10T05:26Z). The recomputed gaps for 2026-10-06 and 2026-10-07 therefore do not match the published gaps; the criterion is left to fail on that honest result.
